description: This file contains unit tests for the BatchManagerCondition class, specifically testing its behavior based on environment property settings related to batch manager enabling.

classes.name: BatchManagerConditionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BatchManagerCondition, testing different scenarios of environment property values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock environment and sets up the condition context before each test.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenManagerDisabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition returns false when the batch manager is disabled in environment properties.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenManagerEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition returns true when the batch manager is enabled in environment properties.
